Item 5.03 Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Changes in Fiscal Year On July 17, 2025, the Board of Directors (the “ Board ” ) of Micron Technology, Inc. (the “ Company ” ) approved the Company ’ s Amended and Restated Bylaws (the “ Amended Bylaws ” ), effective as of such date. The Amended Bylaws include an amendment to adjust the Company ’ s existing Delaware exclusive forum provision to reflect changes in the laws of the state of Delaware, and other ministerial, clarifying and conforming changes. This description of the amendment to the Company ’ s bylaws is qualified in its entirety by reference to the text of the Amended Bylaws filed as Exhibit 3.1 to this report. Item 9.01.
